pipeline: GLTFLoader -> MotionScene -> MotionSceneBridge -> threepp GLRenderer -> diagnostic PNG
renderer: NVIDIA RTX A4000/PCIe/SSE2, GL 3.3.0 NVIDIA 595.99.02, EGL headless
scope: Internal regression baseline produced by the certified renderer from a pinned Khronos asset. It is not the Khronos glTF Sample Viewer reference image and does not prove color-managed PBR parity against an independent viewer.
notes: The frame is the middle diagnostic frame of a 150-frame 30 fps run.
The comparison is byte-identical on the same GPU and driver; the tolerance exists for driver/EGL variation, not for scene edits.
Any intentional visual change must regenerate the golden and update image_sha256 plus baseline_measurement.
